Class NitriteSortKeys

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.model.query.builder.NitriteSortKeys
@Internal public final class NitriteSortKeys extends Object
The two shapes a $sort takes, and the translation between them and NitriteSortKey.

A sort whose every key is a stored field with no null placement of its own keeps the map shape {"field": 1} it has always had, so a query compiled before sort keys existed still reads the same. Anything a map cannot say - an expression key, or a null placement - is written as a list of key objects instead.

Since:
5.2.0
